@deepseek-ai/dsh-cua-bundle.description: Currently supports macOS; Windows support is in development. Loads computer use for existing and new PTC sessions. Switch to PTC mode and grant Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions to use it.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-cua-bundle.descriptionZh: 目前仅支持 macOS，Windows 支持正在开发中。为已有及新建 PTC 会话加载 Computer Use。请切换到 PTC 模式来使用，并授予辅助功能和屏幕录制权限。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team.description: Lets the agent you talk to split a job among named teammates, track it on a shared task board, and report back with their results.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team.descriptionZh: 让与你对话的智能体把工作分给有名字的队友，在共享任务看板上跟踪进度，并汇总队友的结果向你汇报。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-revie.description: Adds an Auto review access mode: before each tool call, a model checks it against what you asked for, runs allowed calls at once, and holds denied calls for your approval.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-revie.descriptionZh: 提供“自动审查”访问模式：每次工具调用前，由模型对照你的要求检查，获准的调用立即运行，被拒绝的调用等你审批。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-badge-skil.description: Let agents add a “powered by dsh” badge to documents, pull requests, and other outputs.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-badge-skil.descriptionZh: 让 Agent 为文档、PR 等产出添加「powered by dsh」徽章。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-cot-transl.description: Translates expanded Think rows into your chosen language as the agent writes them, and View original switches back.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-cot-transl.descriptionZh: 智能体输出时，把展开的“思考”行翻译成你选择的语言，点击“查看原文”可切换回原文。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-forge-bund.description: Track each Session's change requests with their checks and reviews, and start new Sessions in a Git worktree; uses the gh CLI for GitHub.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-forge-bund.descriptionZh: 跟踪每个会话的变更请求及其检查与评审，新会话也可以在 Git 工作树中开始；GitHub 通过 gh 命令行访问。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector-.description: For troubleshooting: view what DSH recorded for a session in Session log, inspect per-turn and per-step statistics in the Statistics tab, and debug the DSH backend in Chrome DevTools.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector-.descriptionZh: 用于排查问题：在「会话数据诊断」中查看 DSH 为会话记录的内容，在「统计」页签查看每轮/每步的上下文、耗时、缓存和工具成本，并在 Chrome DevTools 中调试 DSH 后端。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-liveshare.description: Share the current Session with a colleague, who can drive it in a browser, edit files inside the granted workspace when the share allows writes, or branch their own Session from the completed history.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-liveshare.descriptionZh: 把当前会话分享给同事，对方可在浏览器中驱动该会话、在分享允许写入时修改授权工作区内的文件，或从已完成历史分支出自己的会话。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-plugin-mar.description: Adds a Discover tab to Plugins, where you browse and install plugins from plugin indexes you add.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-plugin-mar.descriptionZh: 在插件页添加“发现”标签页，从你添加的插件索引中浏览和安装插件。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-ralph-bund.description: Ask for a Ralph loop with a goal, and the agent starts a fresh agent on it round after round until the goal is met, a blocker is reported, or the round limit is reached.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-ralph-bund.descriptionZh: 要求用 Ralph 循环完成一个目标后，智能体会一轮接一轮地启动新的智能体处理它，直到目标达成、报告受阻或达到轮次上限。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-se.description: Ask about earlier work, such as “How did we fix the pool leak last week?”, and the agent searches your earlier sessions in the same workspace to answer.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-se.descriptionZh: 询问以往的工作，例如“上周我们是怎么修好连接池泄漏的？”，智能体会搜索同一工作区的历史会话来回答。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-ti.description: Writes a session's title from all of your messages and updates it when the main task changes, instead of only from the first message.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-ti.descriptionZh: 根据你的所有消息生成会话标题，并在主要任务变化时更新，而不是只根据第一条消息生成。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-terminal-b.description: Gives the agent terminals whose processes keep running in the background between tool calls, so it can start a dev server or REPL and come back later to read output or type input.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-terminal-b.descriptionZh: 为智能体提供终端，进程在多次工具调用之间持续在后台运行，因此它可以启动开发服务器或 REPL，稍后再读取输出或继续输入。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-workt.description: Ask for work on a new branch, and the agent creates a separate Git worktree and continues there, leaving your current checkout as it is.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-workt.descriptionZh: 要求在新分支上工作时，智能体会创建单独的 Git 工作树并在其中继续，你当前的工作树保持原样。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-inpu.description: Transcribe recordings locally with SenseVoice; first use requires installing dependencies.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-inpu.descriptionZh: 在本机使用 SenseVoice 转写录音，首次使用需安装依赖。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-personalized-recommenda.description: Shows recommendation cards below the answer for what you want from DSH: when you want a page or small tool you can keep, it proposes a new personalized page, built in the background after you click Create; when you ask how to do something in this app or say a capability is missing, it recommends the built-in plugin that provides it, turned on when you click Enable.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-personalized-recommenda.descriptionZh: 针对你对 DSH 的个性化需求，在回答下方展示推荐卡片：想要能长期使用的页面或小工具时，提议新增个性化页面，点击创建后在后台生成；问到本应用怎么做某件事或缺少某项能力时，推荐对应的内置插件，点击启用后开启。
